name: 2025-reefscape

sources.drawing: FE-2025 Field Layout and Marking rev C
sources.tags: WPILib v2025.3.2 apriltag resources (identical to FE-2025 sheet 4)

_units: Everything under 'field' and 'pieces' is in INCHES (as in the drawings). 'model' is SI.

reef._note: reef_tags are listed face 0..5: face 0 faces the alliance wall, then CCW seen from above (blue). Red is the 180 deg rotation of blue.

algae_rest._note: MEASURED from the official CAD (tools/check_field.py): staged ALGAE cradled by the L2 (low) or L3 (high) branch pair, against the two pipes. outward = along the face normal from the reef tag plane.

trough_slots._note: MEASURED from the official CAD: CORAL lie end to end along the face in the trough channel (3 per layer); a 2nd layer rests on the 1st, a 3rd would hit the L2 branches. outward = along the face normal from the reef tag plane.

field._starting_line: reef face 209.49 + 88 (manual 5.2); matches FE-2025 sheet 5 (61.76 from processor centre 235.73)

barge._center_support: MEASURED from the official CAD (FE-2025 glb): truss footprint x 8.621..8.926 m, y 3.874..4.179 m = 12 x 12 in. (A 24x24 in, 3-6 mm base plate underneath is drivable.)

cages._note: hang on the barge centreline (x = length/2); blue at y > width/2, red below. CAD: centres at 41.5/84.4/127.3 in from mid-field; middle cage shallow (bottom 30.1 in), outer two deep (3.1 in).

field._guardrail_inset_m: MEASURED from the official CAD (tools/check_field.py): guardrail inner faces are 2.7 cm inside the 317 in width from the tag file; the alliance walls match exactly.

model._note: MODELLING ASSUMPTIONS (not in the manual). SI units. Confirmed with team lead 2026-10-26.
model._l1_capacity_per_face: Manual 6.5.1: a CORAL counts in the trough if it touches the trough or rests on CORAL that does (no count limit). 2 layers x 3 fit the CAD trough (field.reef.trough_slots).
model._stop: Placing / receiving pieces needs the robot (nearly) stopped: the dwell timer of stop_goals only runs below these speeds. Floor intakes and climbing work on the move.
model._virtual_align: auto_align off: the robot's own drive-to-pose is not simulated; its time is added to the dwell instead: settle + distance(lateral to the target, gap beyond gap_m) / speed + heading error / omega. World-championship level estimates.
model._foul_referee: Contact fouls (G403, G405/G418, G427, G428): a contact starts a new interaction only after the robots were apart for foul_sep_s; one foul when it starts, one more per foul_repeat_s of continued contact (referee model, not in the manual; replaces the 3 s per-pair cooldown that still let flickering contact draw hundreds of fouls).
model._pin: G425: count, 6 ft and 3 s end criteria from the manual; a robot is pinned while it touches the opponent, is held by the field or another robot, and moves slower than pin_victim_speed_mps (model).
